title: Doodle Market
description: A full-stack Vite, React, TypeScript, Express app for uploading, selling, and rating doodles. Demonstrates backend concepts like JWT authentication, ownership-based authorization, purchase flow, transactional emails, audit logging, rate limiting, integration testing, and admin tooling.

title: Astro Starter
description: Production-ready Astro template built to rank. Ships with a TypeScript-first architecture, SCSS design token system, structured data, and Core Web Vitals optimizations, so new content sites start with strong SEO foundations out of the box.

title: Video Searcher
description: AI-powered video analysis tool that turns long-form video into searchable, timestamped moments. Users upload any video, enter a natural-language query, and the app returns the exact scenes that match, powered by Vertex AI video intelligence with OAuth2-secured access and rate limiting.

title: GGList
description: Full-stack web app with Google OAuth authentication, Cloud SQL persistence, and interactive data visualization via Chart.js. Users can save, rate, and analyze their collections. It demonstrates end-to-end auth, relational data modeling, and a modern React + Node.js architecture deployed on GCP.

title: Upload Center
description: GCP-native multi-modal AI platform that extracts structured insights from unstructured content. Supports text sentiment analysis, image recognition, and CSV data profiling, all processed through Vertex AI and Gemini models with results stored and queryable in BigQuery.

title: Nerd by Day, Nerd by Night
description: End-to-end e-commerce platform built from scratch on GCP. Handles product catalog, Stripe payment processing, order management, and Cloud SQL persistence with no third-party storefront and full control over the stack.

title: Susie Jetta
description: Client site for a small business owner, designed, built, and deployed to production on GCP. Includes Cloud Build CI/CD, Cloud Storage for media assets, and a performant React frontend optimized for local SEO and mobile conversion.
